1.en: The one who delights in God's instruction is like a tree planted by streams of water, while the wicked are like chaff that the wind blows away.
1.sw: Mtu anayefurahia mafundisho ya Mungu ni kama mti uliopandwa kando ya vijito vya maji, lakini waovu ni kama makapi yanayotawanywa na upepo.
1.am: በእግዚአብሔር ትምህርት ደስ የሚለው ሰው በወራጅ ውኃ ዳር እንደ ተተከለ ዛፍ ነው፤ ክፉዎች ግን ነፋስ እንደሚበትነው ገለባ ናቸው።

2.en: The nations plot against God and the anointed king, but God laughs at them and declares the king to be God's son, set on Zion; the rulers are warned to serve God.
2.sw: Mataifa wanapanga njama dhidi ya Mungu na dhidi ya mfalme aliyepakwa mafuta, lakini Mungu anawacheka na kumtangaza mfalme kuwa mwana wa Mungu, aliyewekwa juu ya Sayuni; watawala wanaonywa wamtumikie Mungu.
2.am: ሕዝቦች በእግዚአብሔርና በቀባው ንጉሥ ላይ ያሤራሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ይሥቅባቸዋል፤ በጽዮን ላይ የተሾመውን ንጉሥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ ያውጃል፤ ገዦችም እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያገለግሉ ይመከራሉ።

3.en: David, fleeing from Absalom, cries out that his enemies are many, yet he lies down and sleeps, for God is his shield and rescue.
3.sw: Daudi, akimkimbia Absalomu, analia kwamba adui zake ni wengi, lakini analala na kupata usingizi, kwa maana Mungu ni ngao yake na mwokozi wake.
3.am: ዳዊት ከአቤሴሎም እየሸሸ ጠላቶቹ ብዙ እንደ ሆኑ ይጮኻል፤ ሆኖም ይተኛል፤ ያንቀላፋልም፤ እግዚአብሔር ጋሻውና አዳኙ ነውና።

4.en: David calls on God to answer him and tells others to trust God; God has given him more joy than a rich harvest, and he sleeps in peace.
4.sw: Daudi anamwita Mungu amjibu na kuwaambia wengine wamtumaini Mungu; Mungu amempa furaha kuliko mavuno mengi, naye analala kwa amani.
4.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር እንዲመልስለት ይጣራል፤ ሌሎችም በእግዚአብሔር እንዲታመኑ ይነግራቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከብዙ መከር የበለጠ ደስታ ሰጥቶታል፤ እርሱም በሰላም ይተኛል።

5.en: David prays in the morning for God to hear him and lead him in righteousness, for God hates evil, and he asks God to protect those who take refuge in God.
5.sw: Daudi anaomba asubuhi Mungu amsikie na kumwongoza katika haki, kwa maana Mungu anachukia uovu, na anamwomba Mungu awalinde wale wanaomkimbilia.
5.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰማውና በጽድቅ እንዲመራው በጧት ይጸልያል፤ እግዚአብሔር ክፋትን ይጠላልና፤ ወደ እርሱ የሚጠጉትንም እንዲጠብቃቸው ይለምናል።

6.en: In distress and illness David begs God not to correct him in anger; worn out with weeping, he is sure that God has heard his cry.
6.sw: Katika dhiki na ugonjwa Daudi anamsihi Mungu asimrudi kwa hasira; akiwa amechoka kwa kulia, ana hakika kwamba Mungu amesikia kilio chake.
6.am: ዳዊት በጭንቅና በሕመም ውስጥ ሆኖ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣ እንዳይገሥጸው ይማጸናል፤ በልቅሶ ደክሞ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር ጩኸቱን እንደ ሰማ እርግጠኛ ነው።

7.en: David takes refuge in God against those who pursue him and asks God, the righteous judge, to vindicate him.
7.sw: Daudi anamkimbilia Mungu dhidi ya wale wanaomfuatia na anamwomba Mungu, mwamuzi mwadilifu, amthibitishe kuwa hana hatia.
7.am: ዳዊት ከሚያሳድዱት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጠጋል፤ ጻድቁ ዳኛ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲፈርድለት ይለምናል።

8.en: God's name is glorious in all the earth; when David looks at the heavens he wonders that God cares for human beings and has crowned them with glory over all creation.
8.sw: Jina la Mungu ni tukufu katika dunia yote; Daudi anapozitazama mbingu anashangaa kwamba Mungu anawajali wanadamu na amewavika taji ya utukufu juu ya viumbe vyote.
8.am: የእግዚአብሔር ስም በምድር ሁሉ የከበረ ነው፤ ዳዊት ሰማያትን ሲመለከት እግዚአብሔር ስለ ሰው እንደሚያስብና በፍጥረት ሁሉ ላይ የክብር ዘውድ እንዳቀዳጀው ይደነቃል።

9.en: David thanks God for judging the nations with justice and for being a stronghold for the oppressed, who are not forgotten.
9.sw: Daudi anamshukuru Mungu kwa kuyahukumu mataifa kwa haki na kwa kuwa ngome kwa walioonewa, ambao hawasahauliwi.
9.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቦችን በፍትሕ ስለሚፈርድና ለተጨቈኑት፣ ለማይረሱትም መጠጊያ ስለ ሆነ ያመሰግነዋል።

10.en: The psalmist asks why God seems far away while the wicked hunt down the poor, and calls on God to rise up, for God hears the afflicted and defends the fatherless.
10.sw: Mtunga zaburi anauliza kwa nini Mungu anaonekana kuwa mbali wakati waovu wanawawinda maskini, na anamwita Mungu ainuke, kwa maana Mungu huwasikia wanaoteseka na kuwatetea yatima.
10.am: መዝሙረኛው ክፉዎች ድሆችን እያደኑ ሳሉ እግዚአብሔር ለምን የራቀ እንደሚመስል ይጠይቃል፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲነሣ ይጣራል፤ እግዚአብሔር የተጨነቁትን ይሰማልና፤ ድሀ አደጎችንም ይሟገትላቸዋል።

11.en: When advised to flee like a bird, David declares that he takes refuge in God, who sees from heaven and loves justice.
11.sw: Anaposhauriwa akimbie kama ndege, Daudi anatangaza kwamba anamkimbilia Mungu, anayeona kutoka mbinguni na kupenda haki.
11.am: ዳዊት እንደ ወፍ እንዲሸሽ በተመከረ ጊዜ ከሰማይ ሆኖ የሚያየውንና ፍትሕን የሚወደውን እግዚአብሔርን መጠጊያው እንዳደረገ ያውጃል።

12.en: When the faithful have vanished and everyone speaks lies, God promises to rise up for the poor, and God's words are pure as refined silver.
12.sw: Waaminifu wanapotoweka na kila mtu anasema uongo, Mungu anaahidi kuinuka kwa ajili ya maskini, na maneno ya Mungu ni safi kama fedha iliyosafishwa.
12.am: ታማኞች ሲጠፉና ሰው ሁሉ ሐሰት ሲናገር እግዚአብሔር ለድሆች እንደሚነሣ ተስፋ ይሰጣል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል እንደ ተጣራ ብር ንጹሕ ነው።

13.en: David asks how long God will forget him, then trusts in God's loyal love and sings of God's goodness.
13.sw: Daudi anauliza Mungu atamsahau mpaka lini, kisha anautumainia upendo usiokoma wa Mungu na kuuimba wema wa Mungu.
13.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር እስከ መቼ እንደሚረሳው ይጠይቃል፤ ከዚያም በእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ፍቅር ይታመናል፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔርም ቸርነት ይዘምራል።

14.en: Fools say there is no God, and no one does good, yet God is with the righteous and will restore the fortunes of God's people.
14.sw: Wapumbavu wanasema hakuna Mungu, na hakuna atendaye mema, lakini Mungu yuko pamoja na waadilifu na atawarudishia watu wake hali yao njema.
14.am: ሰነፎች «እግዚአብሔር የለም» ይላሉ፤ በጎ የሚያደርግም የለም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ከጻድቃን ጋር ነው፤ የሕዝቡንም ዕድል ፈንታ ይመልሳል።

15.en: David asks who may dwell on God's holy mountain: the one who walks without blame, speaks truth and keeps his word.
15.sw: Daudi anauliza ni nani awezaye kukaa katika mlima mtakatifu wa Mungu: yule anayeenenda bila lawama, anayesema kweli na kutimiza neno lake.
15.am: ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ተራራ ላይ ማን ሊኖር እንደሚችል ይጠይቃል፦ ያለ ነቀፋ የሚመላለስ፣ እውነትን የሚናገርና ቃሉን የሚጠብቅ ነው።

16.en: David has made God his refuge and his portion; he will not be abandoned to the grave but shown the path of life and fullness of joy.
16.sw: Daudi amemfanya Mungu kuwa kimbilio lake na fungu lake; hataachwa Kuzimu bali ataonyeshwa njia ya uzima na furaha tele.
16.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን መጠጊያውና ድርሻው አድርጎታል፤ በሙታን ዓለም አይተውም፤ የሕይወትን መንገድና የተትረፈረፈ ደስታን ይታይበታል።

17.en: David appeals to God to hear his just cause and to hide him in the shadow of God's wings from the wicked.
17.sw: Daudi anamsihi Mungu asikie shauri lake la haki na amfiche katika kivuli cha mabawa ya Mungu mbali na waovu.
17.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ትክክለኛ ጉዳዩን እንዲሰማውና ከክፉዎች በክንፎቹ ጥላ ሥር እንዲሰውረው ይማጸናል።

18.en: David sings of the day God rescued him from all his enemies: God, his rock and fortress, came down in storm and thunder and drew him out of deep waters.
18.sw: Daudi anaimba juu ya siku ambayo Mungu alimwokoa kutoka kwa adui zake wote: Mungu, mwamba wake na ngome yake, alishuka katika dhoruba na ngurumo na kumtoa katika maji mengi.
18.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ከጠላቶቹ ሁሉ ስላዳነበት ቀን ይዘምራል፦ ዓለቱና ምሽጉ እግዚአብሔር በማዕበልና በነጐድጓድ ወረደ፤ ከጥልቅ ውኃም አወጣው።

19.en: The heavens declare God's glory, and God's instruction is perfect, more precious than gold; David prays that his words and thoughts may please God.
19.sw: Mbingu zinatangaza utukufu wa Mungu, na mafundisho ya Mungu ni kamili, yenye thamani kuliko dhahabu; Daudi anaomba maneno na mawazo yake yampendeze Mungu.
19.am: ሰማያት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ያውጃሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ትምህርት ፍጹም ነው፤ ከወርቅም ይበልጥ የከበረ ነው፤ ዳዊት ቃሉና ሐሳቡ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እንዲያሰኙ ይጸልያል።

20.en: The people pray that God will answer the king in the day of trouble and give him victory, for they trust not in chariots but in God's name.
20.sw: Watu wanaomba Mungu amjibu mfalme siku ya taabu na kumpa ushindi, kwa maana hawatumaini magari ya vita bali jina la Mungu.
20.am: ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር በመከራ ቀን ለንጉሡ እንዲመልስለትና ድል እንዲሰጠው ይጸልያሉ፤ በሰረገሎች ሳይሆን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ይታመናሉና።

21.en: The king rejoices in God's strength and saving help, and trusts that God will defeat his enemies.
21.sw: Mfalme anafurahia nguvu za Mungu na msaada wake wa kuokoa, na anatumaini kwamba Mungu atawashinda adui zake.
21.am: ንጉሡ በእግዚአብሔር ብርታትና በሚያድነው ርዳታው ደስ ይለዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቹን እንደሚያሸንፍም ይታመናል።

22.en: David cries, "My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?" surrounded by mocking enemies, then praises God who has heard him, and all the earth will turn to God.
22.sw: Daudi analia, "Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, kwa nini umenitupa?" akiwa amezungukwa na adui wanaomdhihaki, kisha anamsifu Mungu aliyemsikia, na dunia yote itamgeukia Mungu.
22.am: ዳዊት በሚሣለቁበት ጠላቶች ተከብቦ «አምላኬ፣ አምላኬ፣ ለምን ተውኸኝ?» ብሎ ይጮኻል፤ ከዚያም የሰማውን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል፤ ምድርም ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ትመለሳለች።

23.en: God is David's shepherd, who leads him to rest, guides him through the darkest valley and spreads a table before him; goodness and love will follow him all his life.
23.sw: Mungu ndiye mchungaji wa Daudi, anayemwongoza mahali pa kupumzika, anayemwongoza kupitia bonde la giza kuu kabisa na kumwandalia meza; wema na upendo usiokoma vitamfuata maisha yake yote.
23.am: እግዚአብሔር የዳዊት እረኛ ነው፤ ወደ ዕረፍት ይመራዋል፤ ድቅድቅ ጨለማ በዋጠው ሸለቆ ውስጥ ይመራዋል፤ ማዕድም ያዘጋጅለታል፤ መልካምነትና ጽኑ ፍቅር በዕድሜው ሁሉ ይከተሉታል።

24.en: The earth belongs to God, who made it; those with clean hands may stand in God's holy place, and the gates are told to open for the King of glory.
24.sw: Dunia ni mali ya Mungu, aliyeiumba; wale wenye mikono safi wanaweza kusimama katika mahali patakatifu pa Mungu, na malango yanaambiwa yafunguke kwa ajili ya Mfalme wa utukufu.
24.am: ምድር የፈጠራት የእግዚአብሔር ናት፤ ንጹሕ እጆች ያሏቸው በእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ስፍራ ሊቆሙ ይችላሉ፤ በሮችም ለክብር ንጉሥ እንዲከፈቱ ይነገራቸዋል።

25.en: David lifts up his whole self to God, asks to be taught God's ways and forgiven, and trusts God to rescue him.
25.sw: Daudi anajiinua mzima kwa Mungu, anaomba afundishwe njia za Mungu na kusamehewa, na anamtumaini Mungu amwokoe.
25.am: ዳዊት ሁለንተናውን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ያነሣል፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ እንዲማርና ይቅር እንዲባል ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲያድነው ይታመናል።

26.en: David asks God to examine him, for he has walked with integrity and loves the house where God's glory dwells.
26.sw: Daudi anamwomba Mungu amchunguze, kwa maana ameenenda kwa ukamilifu na anaipenda nyumba ambamo utukufu wa Mungu unakaa.
26.am: ዳዊት በንጹሕ አቋም ስለ ተመላለሰና የእግዚአብሔር ክብር የሚያድርበትን ቤት ስለሚወድ እግዚአብሔር እንዲመረምረው ይለምናል።

27.en: God is David's light and salvation, so he has no one to fear; he asks to live in God's house and urges waiting for God.
27.sw: Mungu ni nuru ya Daudi na wokovu wake, kwa hiyo hana mtu wa kumwogopa; anaomba akae katika nyumba ya Mungu na anahimiza kumngojea Mungu.
27.am: እግዚአብሔር የዳዊት ብርሃንና መዳን ነው፤ ስለዚህ የሚፈራው የለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እንዲኖር ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ተስፋ አድርጎ መጠበቅን ያሳስባል።

28.en: David cries out to God, his rock, to hear him and not count him with the wicked, and praises God who has heard.
28.sw: Daudi anamlilia Mungu, mwamba wake, amsikie na asimhesabu pamoja na waovu, na anamsifu Mungu aliyesikia.
28.am: ዳዊት ዓለቱ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰማውና ከክፉዎች ጋር እንዳይቈጥረው ይጮኻል፤ የሰማውንም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል።

29.en: The heavenly beings are called to give God glory, whose voice thunders over the waters and shakes the wilderness, and who blesses the people with peace.
29.sw: Viumbe wa mbinguni wanaitwa kumpa Mungu utukufu, ambaye sauti yake inanguruma juu ya maji na kulitikisa jangwa, na anayewabariki watu wake kwa amani.
29.am: ሰማያውያን ፍጡራን ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር እንዲሰጡ ይጠራሉ፤ ድምፁ በውኆች ላይ ያንጐደጕዳል፤ ምድረ በዳውንም ያናውጻል፤ ሕዝቡንም በሰላም ይባርካል።

30.en: David praises God for lifting him up from the grave; weeping may last for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
30.sw: Daudi anamsifu Mungu kwa kumwinua kutoka Kuzimu; kilio kinaweza kulala usiku, lakini alfajiri kuna kelele za furaha.
30.am: ዳዊት ከሙታን ዓለም ስላወጣው እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል፤ ልቅሶ ሌሊቱን ሊያድር ይችላል፤ ጎሕ ሲቀድ ግን የደስታ እልልታ ይሆናል።

31.en: David commits his spirit into God's hand, tells of his distress and the plots against him, and praises God's goodness to those who take refuge in God.
31.sw: Daudi anaikabidhi roho yake mikononi mwa Mungu, anaeleza dhiki yake na njama dhidi yake, na anausifu wema wa Mungu kwa wale wanaomkimbilia.
31.am: ዳዊት መንፈሱን በእግዚአብሔር እጅ አደራ ይሰጣል፤ ጭንቀቱንና በእርሱ ላይ የተሸረቡትን ሤራዎች ይናገራል፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለሚጠጉትም ያለውን ቸርነቱን ያመሰግናል።

32.en: Those whose rebellion is forgiven are blessed; when David kept silent he wasted away, but when he confessed, God forgave him.
32.sw: Wana heri wale ambao uasi wao umesamehewa; Daudi aliponyamaza alidhoofika, lakini alipoungama, Mungu alimsamehe.
32.am: ዓመፃቸው ይቅር የተባለላቸው የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ ዳዊት ዝም ባለ ጊዜ ተዳከመ፤ በተናዘዘ ጊዜ ግን እግዚአብሔር ይቅር አለው።

33.en: The righteous are called to sing a new song to God, whose word made the heavens and whose eye is on those who fear God and hope in God's loyal love.
33.sw: Waadilifu wanaitwa kumwimbia Mungu wimbo mpya, ambaye neno lake liliziumba mbingu na ambaye jicho lake liko juu ya wale wanaomcha na kuutumainia upendo wake usiokoma.
33.am: ጻድቃን ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ መዝሙር እንዲዘምሩ ይጠራሉ፤ ቃሉ ሰማያትን ፈጠረ፤ ዓይኑም በሚፈሩትና ጽኑ ፍቅሩን ተስፋ በሚያደርጉት ላይ ነው።

34.en: David praises God, who answered him and delivered him from all his fears, and invites others to taste and see that God is good.
34.sw: Daudi anamsifu Mungu, aliyemjibu na kumwokoa kutoka kwa hofu zake zote, na anawaalika wengine waonje waone jinsi Mungu alivyo mwema.
34.am: ዳዊት የመለሰለትንና ከፍርሃቱ ሁሉ ያዳነውን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል፤ ሌሎችም እግዚአብሔር ምን ያህል ቸር እንደ ሆነ ቀምሰው እንዲያዩ ይጋብዛል።

35.en: David asks God to fight those who fight against him and repay those who return evil for good.
35.sw: Daudi anamwomba Mungu apigane na wale wanaopigana naye na kuwalipa wale wanaolipa mabaya kwa mema.
35.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ከሚዋጉት ጋር እንዲዋጋና በመልካም ፈንታ ክፉ የሚመልሱትን እንዲበቀላቸው ይለምናል።

36.en: The wicked have no fear of God, but God's loyal love reaches to the heavens, and with God is the fountain of life.
36.sw: Waovu hawana hofu ya Mungu, lakini upendo usiokoma wa Mungu unafika mpaka mbinguni, na kwa Mungu kuna chemchemi ya uzima.
36.am: ክፉዎች እግዚአብሔርን አይፈሩም፤ የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ፍቅር ግን እስከ ሰማያት ይደርሳል፤ የሕይወትም ምንጭ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

37.en: The righteous are told not to fret over evildoers, who will soon wither, but to trust God and wait patiently, for the meek will inherit the land.
37.sw: Waadilifu wanaambiwa wasihangaike kwa sababu ya watenda maovu, ambao watanyauka upesi, bali wamtumaini Mungu na kungoja kwa subira, kwa maana wanyonge wataimiliki nchi.
37.am: ጻድቃን በቶሎ ስለሚጠወልጉት ክፉ አድራጊዎች እንዳይበሳጩ ይነገራቸዋል፤ ይልቁንም በእግዚአብሔር እንዲታመኑና በትዕግሥት እንዲጠብቁ፤ ትሑታን ምድርን ይወርሳሉና።

38.en: Sick and burdened by guilt, abandoned by friends, David confesses his sin and pleads with God not to forsake him.
38.sw: Akiwa mgonjwa na kulemewa na hatia, ameachwa na rafiki zake, Daudi anaungama dhambi yake na kumsihi Mungu asimwache.
38.am: ዳዊት ታሞ፣ በበደል ተጭኖና ወዳጆቹ ጥለውት ሳለ ኃጢአቱን ይናዘዛል፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳይተወውም ይማጸናል።

39.en: David reflects that human life is a breath and asks God to show him how short his days are; his hope is in God.
39.sw: Daudi anatafakari kwamba maisha ya mwanadamu ni pumzi tu na anamwomba Mungu amwonyeshe jinsi siku zake zilivyo fupi; tumaini lake liko kwa Mungu.
39.am: ዳዊት የሰው ሕይወት እስትንፋስ ብቻ እንደ ሆነ ያሰላስላል፤ ቀኖቹ ምን ያህል አጭር እንደ ሆኑ እግዚአብሔር እንዲያሳየው ይለምናል፤ ተስፋውም በእግዚአብሔር ነው።

40.en: David waited patiently for God, who drew him up from the pit and put a new song in his mouth; he delights to do God's will.
40.sw: Daudi alimngojea Mungu kwa subira, naye akamtoa shimoni na kutia wimbo mpya kinywani mwake; anafurahia kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu.
40.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን በትዕግሥት ጠበቀ፤ እርሱም ከጉድጓድ አወጣው፤ በአፉም አዲስ መዝሙር አኖረ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ ማድረግ ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

41.en: Those who care for the weak are blessed; in sickness, betrayed even by a close friend, David asks God to raise him up.
41.sw: Wana heri wale wanaowajali wanyonge; akiwa mgonjwa, na kusalitiwa hata na rafiki wa karibu, Daudi anamwomba Mungu amwinue.
41.am: ለደካሞች የሚያስቡ የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ ዳዊት ታሞና የቅርብ ወዳጁ እንኳ ከድቶት ሳለ እግዚአብሔር እንዲያነሣው ይለምናል።

42.en: Like a deer longing for streams, the psalmist thirsts for God, and asks his soul why it is downcast: hope in God.
42.sw: Kama paa anavyovitamani vijito, mtunga zaburi anamwonea Mungu kiu, na anaiuliza nafsi yake kwa nini imeinama: mngojee Mungu kwa tumaini.
42.am: መዝሙረኛው ወራጅ ውኃ እንደምትናፍቅ አጋዘን እግዚአብሔርን ይጠማል፤ ነፍሱንም ለምን እንዳቀረቀረች ይጠይቃታል፦ እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርገሽ ጠብቂ።

43.en: The psalmist asks God to send out light and truth to lead him to God's altar, and again urges his soul to hope in God.
43.sw: Mtunga zaburi anamwomba Mungu atume nuru na kweli zimwongoze mpaka madhabahu ya Mungu, na tena anaihimiza nafsi yake imngojee Mungu kwa tumaini.
43.am: መዝሙረኛው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ እንዲመሩት እግዚአብሔር ብርሃንንና እውነትን እንዲልክ ይለምናል፤ ነፍሱም እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ እንድታደርግ እንደ ገና ያሳስባታል።

44.en: Israel recalls God's deeds for their ancestors, yet now they are defeated and scorned though they have not forgotten God; they cry out for God to wake and help.
44.sw: Israeli wanakumbuka matendo ya Mungu kwa ajili ya mababu zao, lakini sasa wameshindwa na kudharauliwa ingawa hawajamsahau Mungu; wanamlilia Mungu aamke na kuwasaidia.
44.am: እስራኤል እግዚአብሔር ለአባቶቻቸው ያደረገውን ያስታውሳሉ፤ አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔርን ሳይረሱ ተሸንፈዋል፤ ተንቀዋልም፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲነቃና እንዲረዳቸው ይጮኻሉ።

45.en: A love song for the king's wedding praises the king's majesty and righteous rule and calls the bride to honor him.
45.sw: Wimbo wa upendo kwa ajili ya harusi ya mfalme unasifu utukufu wa mfalme na utawala wake wa haki, na unamwita bibi arusi amheshimu.
45.am: ለንጉሡ ሠርግ የተዘመረ የፍቅር መዝሙር የንጉሡን ግርማና የጽድቅ አገዛዙን ያመሰግናል፤ ሙሽራይቱም እንድታከብረው ይጠራታል።

46.en: God is our refuge and strength, so we will not fear though the earth gives way; God is in the city, and the nations are told to be still and know God.
46.sw: Mungu ni kimbilio letu na nguvu zetu, kwa hiyo hatutaogopa hata dunia ikitikisika; Mungu yuko ndani ya mji, na mataifa yanaambiwa yakome na kukiri kwamba yeye ni Mungu.
46.am: እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያችንና ብርታታችን ነው፤ ስለዚህ ምድር ብትናወጥም አንፈራም፤ እግዚአብሔር በከተማዪቱ ውስጥ ነው፤ ሕዝቦችም እንዲተዉና እርሱ አምላክ መሆኑን እንዲያውቁ ይነገራቸዋል።

47.en: All peoples are called to clap and shout to God, the great King over all the earth.
47.sw: Watu wote wanaitwa kupiga makofi na kumpigia Mungu kelele za shangwe, Mfalme mkuu juu ya dunia yote.
47.am: ሕዝቦች ሁሉ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ንጉሥ ለሆነው ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲያጨበጭቡና እልል እንዲሉ ይጠራሉ።

48.en: Zion, the city of God, is beautiful and secure; kings who saw it fled in terror, and God will guide God's people forever.
48.sw: Sayuni, mji wa Mungu, ni mzuri na salama; wafalme walioiona walikimbia kwa hofu, na Mungu atawaongoza watu wake milele.
48.am: የእግዚአብሔር ከተማ ጽዮን ውብና አስተማማኝ ናት፤ ያዩአት ነገሥታት በድንጋጤ ሸሹ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቡን ለዘላለም ይመራል።

49.en: Wealth cannot ransom anyone from death; the rich and the foolish perish alike, but God will redeem the psalmist's life from the grave.
49.sw: Mali haiwezi kumkomboa mtu kutoka kwa kifo; matajiri na wapumbavu wanaangamia vivyo hivyo, lakini Mungu ataukomboa uhai wa mtunga zaburi kutoka Kuzimu.
49.am: ሀብት ማንንም ከሞት ሊዋጅ አይችልም፤ ባለጠጎችና ሰነፎች አብረው ይጠፋሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን የመዝሙረኛውን ሕይወት ከሙታን ዓለም ይዋጃል።

50.en: God summons heaven and earth to judge the people: God needs no sacrifices but wants thanksgiving and faithfulness, and rebukes the wicked.
50.sw: Mungu anaziita mbingu na dunia ili kuwahukumu watu: Mungu hahitaji dhabihu bali anataka shukrani na uaminifu, na anawakemea waovu.
50.am: እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ላይ ለመፍረድ ሰማይንና ምድርን ይጠራል፦ እግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት አያስፈልገውም፤ ምስጋናንና ታማኝነትን ግን ይፈልጋል፤ ክፉዎችንም ይገሥጻል።

51.en: After Nathan confronts him about Bathsheba, David pleads for mercy and cleansing, asking God to create in him a clean heart; God does not despise a broken spirit.
51.sw: Baada ya nabii Nathani kumkabili kuhusu Bathsheba, Daudi anaomba rehema na kutakaswa, akimwomba Mungu amuumbie moyo uliotakasika; Mungu hakatai roho iliyopondeka.
51.am: ነቢዩ ናታን ስለ ቤትሳቤዕ ከገሠጸው በኋላ ዳዊት ምሕረትንና መንጻትን ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔር ንጹሕ ልብ እንዲፈጥርለትም ይጸልያል፤ እግዚአብሔር የተሰበረን መንፈስ አይንቅም።

52.en: David denounces the boastful man who trusts in wealth and lies, while he is like an olive tree flourishing in God's house.
52.sw: Daudi anamshutumu mtu mwenye kujivuna anayetumainia mali na uongo, wakati yeye ni kama mzeituni unaostawi katika nyumba ya Mungu.
52.am: ዳዊት በሀብትና በሐሰት የሚታመነውን ትዕቢተኛ ሰው ይወቅሰዋል፤ እርሱ ራሱ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደሚለመልም የወይራ ዛፍ ነው።

53.en: Fools say there is no God, and no one does good, yet God will scatter the enemies and restore God's people.
53.sw: Wapumbavu wanasema hakuna Mungu, na hakuna atendaye mema, lakini Mungu atawatawanya adui na kuwarudishia watu wake hali yao njema.
53.am: ሰነፎች «እግዚአብሔር የለም» ይላሉ፤ በጎ የሚያደርግም የለም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ጠላቶችን ይበትናል፤ የሕዝቡንም ዕድል ፈንታ ይመልሳል።

54.en: When the Ziphites betray him, David asks God to save him and vindicate him, and promises to offer thanks.
54.sw: Watu wa Zifu wanapomsaliti, Daudi anamwomba Mungu amwokoe na kumtetea, na anaahidi kutoa shukrani.
54.am: የዚፍ ሰዎች አሳልፈው ሲሰጡት ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር እንዲያድነውና እንዲፈርድለት ይለምናል፤ ምስጋና እንደሚያቀርብም ቃል ይገባል።

55.en: David grieves that a close friend has betrayed him; he longs for wings to fly away, but casts his burden on God.
55.sw: Daudi anahuzunika kwamba rafiki wa karibu amemsaliti; anatamani mabawa ili aruke aende mbali, lakini anamtwika Mungu mzigo wake.
55.am: ዳዊት የቅርብ ወዳጁ ስለ ከዳው ያዝናል፤ በርሮ ለመሄድ ክንፍ ይመኛል፤ ሸክሙን ግን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ይጥላል።

56.en: When the Philistines seize him in Gath, David trusts God and is not afraid, for God keeps count of his tears.
56.sw: Wafilisti wanapomkamata huko Gathi, Daudi anamtumaini Mungu na haogopi, kwa maana Mungu anahesabu machozi yake.
56.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያን በጌት በያዙት ጊዜ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ይታመናል፤ አይፈራምም፤ እግዚአብሔር እንባውን ይቈጥራልና።

57.en: Hiding in the cave from Saul, David takes refuge in the shadow of God's wings and resolves to sing God's praise among the nations.
57.sw: Akijificha pangoni mbali na Sauli, Daudi anakimbilia katika kivuli cha mabawa ya Mungu na kuazimia kumwimbia Mungu sifa kati ya mataifa.
57.am: ዳዊት ከሳኦል በዋሻ ተሸሽጎ ሳለ በእግዚአብሔር ክንፎች ጥላ ሥር ይጠጋል፤ በሕዝቦችም መካከል ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና ለመዘመር ይቈርጣል።

58.en: David denounces unjust rulers and asks God to break their power, so that people will know that God judges the earth.
58.sw: Daudi anawashutumu watawala wasio wa haki na anamwomba Mungu avunje nguvu zao, ili watu wajue kwamba Mungu anaihukumu dunia.
58.am: ዳዊት ፍትሕ የሌላቸውን ገዦች ይወቅሳል፤ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔር በምድር ላይ እንደሚፈርድ እንዲያውቁ እግዚአብሔር ኀይላቸውን እንዲሰብር ይለምናል።

59.en: When Saul's men watch his house, David asks God to rescue him from his enemies and praises God as his fortress.
59.sw: Watu wa Sauli wanapoilinda nyumba yake, Daudi anamwomba Mungu amwokoe kutoka kwa adui zake na anamsifu Mungu kama ngome yake.
59.am: የሳኦል ሰዎች ቤቱን ሲጠብቁ ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ከጠላቶቹ እንዲያድነው ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ምሽጉ ብሎ ያመሰግናል።

60.en: After defeat, the people ask God to restore them, and God promises to divide the land and humble their enemies.
60.sw: Baada ya kushindwa, watu wanamwomba Mungu awarejeshe, na Mungu anaahidi kuigawanya nchi na kuwanyenyekesha adui zao.
60.am: ከሽንፈት በኋላ ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር እንዲመልሳቸው ይለምናሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ምድሪቱን እንደሚያካፍልና ጠላቶቻቸውን እንደሚያዋርድ ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

61.en: From the ends of the earth David cries out to God, his rock and refuge, and prays for the king's long life.
61.sw: Kutoka miisho ya dunia Daudi anamlilia Mungu, mwamba wake na kimbilio lake, na anaomba mfalme apate maisha marefu.
61.am: ዳዊት ከምድር ዳርቻ ዓለቱና መጠጊያው ወደ ሆነው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻል፤ ለንጉሡም ረጅም ዕድሜ ይጸልያል።

62.en: David waits in quiet for God alone, his rock and salvation, and urges people to trust in God at all times rather than in wealth.
62.sw: Daudi anamngojea Mungu peke yake kwa utulivu, mwamba wake na wokovu wake, na anawahimiza watu wamtumaini Mungu wakati wote badala ya mali.
62.am: ዳዊት ዓለቱንና መዳኑን እግዚአብሔርን ብቻ በጸጥታ ይጠብቃል፤ ሰዎችም ከሀብት ይልቅ ሁልጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር እንዲታመኑ ያሳስባል።

63.en: In the wilderness David thirsts for God, whose loyal love is better than life, and clings to God.
63.sw: Jangwani Daudi anamwonea Mungu kiu, ambaye upendo wake usiokoma una thamani kuliko uhai, na anashikamana na Mungu.
63.am: ዳዊት በምድረ በዳ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ከሕይወት የሚበልጠውን እግዚአብሔርን ይጠማል፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ጋር ይጣበቃል።

64.en: David asks God to protect him from the secret plots of evildoers, whom God will strike down.
64.sw: Daudi anamwomba Mungu amlinde kutoka kwa njama za siri za watenda maovu, ambao Mungu atawaangusha.
64.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ከክፉ አድራጊዎች ስውር ሤራ እንዲጠብቀው ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይመታቸዋል።

65.en: God answers prayer, forgives, and crowns the year with abundance, making the meadows and valleys shout for joy.
65.sw: Mungu hujibu maombi, husamehe, na kuuvika mwaka taji ya wingi, akifanya malisho na mabonde yapige kelele za furaha.
65.am: እግዚአብሔር ጸሎትን ይመልሳል፤ ይቅር ይላል፤ ዓመቱንም በበረከት ያቀዳጃል፤ መስኮችና ሸለቆዎችም በደስታ እልል እንዲሉ ያደርጋል።

66.en: All the earth is called to praise God for awesome deeds, such as bringing Israel through the sea and through trials, and the psalmist tells what God has done for him.
66.sw: Dunia yote inaitwa kumsifu Mungu kwa matendo yake ya kutisha, kama kuwapitisha Israeli katika bahari na katika majaribu, na mtunga zaburi anasimulia kile Mungu alichomtendea.
66.am: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ስለሚያስፈሩ ሥራዎቹ እንድታመሰግን ትጠራለች፤ ከእነዚህም እስራኤልን በባሕርና በፈተና ውስጥ ማሳለፉ ይገኝበታል፤ መዝሙረኛውም እግዚአብሔር ያደረገለትን ይናገራል።

67.en: The people pray that God will bless them so that all nations will know God's ways and praise God.
67.sw: Watu wanaomba Mungu awabariki ili mataifa yote yajue njia za Mungu na kumsifu Mungu.
67.am: ሕዝቦች ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ እንዲያውቁና እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመሰግኑ ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር እንዲባርካቸው ይጸልያሉ።

68.en: God rises up and enemies scatter; God, father of the fatherless, leads the people from Sinai to the sanctuary, and the kingdoms of the earth are called to sing to God.
68.sw: Mungu anainuka na adui wanatawanyika; Mungu, baba wa yatima, anawaongoza watu wake kutoka Sinai mpaka mahali patakatifu, na falme za dunia zinaitwa kumwimbia Mungu.
68.am: እግዚአብሔር ይነሣል፤ ጠላቶችም ይበተናሉ፤ የድሀ አደጎች አባት እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ከሲና ወደ መቅደሱ ይመራል፤ የምድር መንግሥታትም ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲዘምሩ ይጠራሉ።

69.en: Sinking in deep water and hated without cause, the psalmist pleads for rescue and asks God to repay his enemies.
69.sw: Akizama katika maji mengi na kuchukiwa bila sababu, mtunga zaburi anaomba aokolewe na anamwomba Mungu awalipe adui zake.
69.am: መዝሙረኛው በጥልቅ ውኃ እየሰመጠና ያለ ምክንያት እየተጠላ መዳንን ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ጠላቶቹን እንዲበቀልለት ይጠይቃል።

70.en: David asks God to hurry to save him, and to let all who seek God rejoice.
70.sw: Daudi anamwomba Mungu afanye haraka kumwokoa, na kwamba wote wanaomtafuta Mungu wafurahi.
70.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር እርሱን ለማዳን እንዲፈጥን፣ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልጉትም ሁሉ ደስ እንዲላቸው ይለምናል።

71.en: From his youth to old age the psalmist has relied on God, and he asks God not to forsake him now that he is gray.
71.sw: Tangu ujana wake hadi uzee mtunga zaburi amemtegemea Mungu, na anamwomba Mungu asimwache sasa kwa kuwa ana mvi.
71.am: መዝሙረኛው ከወጣትነቱ እስከ ሽምግልናው በእግዚአብሔር ተደግፏል፤ አሁን ሽበት ሲያወጣ እግዚአብሔር እንዳይተወው ይለምናል።

72.en: A prayer for the king asks that he judge the poor with justice, rule from sea to sea, and that all nations be blessed through him.
72.sw: Maombi kwa ajili ya mfalme yanaomba awahukumu maskini kwa haki, atawale kutoka bahari hadi bahari, na mataifa yote yabarikiwe kupitia kwake.
72.am: ስለ ንጉሡ የሚቀርብ ጸሎት ለድሆች በፍትሕ እንዲፈርድ፣ ከባሕር እስከ ባሕር እንዲገዛ፣ ሕዝቦችም ሁሉ በእርሱ እንዲባረኩ ይለምናል።

73.en: Asaph nearly stumbled when he saw the wicked prosper, until he entered God's sanctuary and understood their end; God is his portion forever.
73.sw: Asafu karibu ajikwae alipowaona waovu wakifanikiwa, hadi alipoingia mahali patakatifu pa Mungu na kuuelewa mwisho wao; Mungu ni fungu lake milele.
73.am: አሳፍ ክፉዎች ሲበለጽጉ አይቶ ሊሰናከል ጥቂት ቀረው፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ገብቶ ፍጻሜያቸውን እስኪያስተውል ድረስ፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ድርሻው ነው።

74.en: The psalmist mourns the enemies' destruction of the sanctuary and asks God to remember the covenant and rise up.
74.sw: Mtunga zaburi anaomboleza uharibifu wa mahali patakatifu uliofanywa na adui na anamwomba Mungu aukumbuke agano na ainuke.
74.am: መዝሙረኛው ጠላቶች መቅደሱን በማፍረሳቸው ያለቅሳል፤ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳኑን እንዲያስብና እንዲነሣም ይለምናል።

75.en: The people give thanks to God, who judges in due time, humbling some and lifting up others.
75.sw: Watu wanamshukuru Mungu, anayehukumu kwa wakati wake, akiwashusha wengine na kuwainua wengine.
75.am: ሕዝቡ በጊዜው የሚፈርደውን፣ አንዱን የሚያዋርደውን ሌላውንም ከፍ የሚያደርገውን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናሉ።

76.en: God is renowned in Judah and breaks the weapons of war; God judges to save the humble of the earth.
76.sw: Mungu anajulikana katika Yuda na anavunja silaha za vita; Mungu anahukumu ili kuwaokoa wanyonge wa dunia.
76.am: እግዚአብሔር በይሁዳ የታወቀ ነው፤ የጦር መሣሪያዎችንም ይሰብራል፤ እግዚአብሔር የምድርን ትሑታን ለማዳን ይፈርዳል።

77.en: In distress the psalmist wonders whether God has forgotten to be gracious, then remembers God's wonders of old, when God led the people through the sea.
77.sw: Katika dhiki mtunga zaburi anajiuliza kama Mungu amesahau kuwa mwenye neema, kisha anakumbuka maajabu ya Mungu ya zamani, Mungu alipowaongoza watu wake kupitia bahari.
77.am: መዝሙረኛው በጭንቅ ውስጥ እግዚአብሔር ቸርነትን ረስቶ እንደሆነ ይጠይቃል፤ ከዚያም እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በባሕር ውስጥ የመራበትን የጥንቱን ተአምራቱን ያስታውሳል።

78.en: Asaph tells the next generation of God's wonders in Egypt and the wilderness and of Israel's repeated rebellion, and how God chose Judah, Zion and David to shepherd the people.
78.sw: Asafu anaiambia kizazi kijacho maajabu ya Mungu huko Misri na jangwani na uasi wa Israeli uliorudiwa, na jinsi Mungu alivyowachagua Yuda, Sayuni na Daudi ili kuwachunga watu wake.
78.am: አሳፍ ለሚመጣው ትውልድ እግዚአብሔር በግብፅና በምድረ በዳ ያደረገውን ተአምራትና የእስራኤልን ተደጋጋሚ ዓመፅ፣ እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቡን እንዲጠብቅ ይሁዳን፣ ጽዮንንና ዳዊትን እንዴት እንደ መረጠ ይተርካል።

79.en: The nations have defiled the temple and laid Jerusalem in ruins, and the people ask God to forgive and to avenge them.
79.sw: Mataifa wamelitia unajisi hekalu na kuifanya Yerusalemu kuwa magofu, na watu wanamwomba Mungu awasamehe na kuwalipiza kisasi.
79.am: ሕዝቦች ቤተ መቅደሱን አርክሰዋል፤ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ፍርስራሽ አድርገዋል፤ ሕዝቡም እግዚአብሔር ይቅር እንዲላቸውና እንዲበቀልላቸው ይለምናሉ።

80.en: The people pray to the Shepherd of Israel to restore them, picturing Israel as a vine brought out of Egypt and now cut down, and ask God to turn the light of God’s face on them so they will be saved.
80.sw: Watu wanamwomba Mchungaji wa Israeli awarejeshe, wakiieleza Israeli kama mzabibu uliotolewa Misri na sasa umekatwa, na wanamwomba Mungu awaangazie nuru ya uso wake ili waokolewe.
80.am: ሕዝቡ የእስራኤል እረኛ እንዲመልሳቸው ይጸልያሉ፤ እስራኤልን ከግብፅ እንደ ወጣና አሁን እንደ ተቈረጠ የወይን ተክል አድርገው ይገልጹታል፤ እንዲድኑም እግዚአብሔር የፊቱን ብርሃን እንዲያበራላቸው ይለምናሉ።

81.en: The people are called to celebrate a festival, and God speaks, longing for Israel to listen and walk in God's ways.
81.sw: Watu wanaitwa kuadhimisha sikukuu, na Mungu anasema, akitamani Israeli wasikilize na kuenenda katika njia za Mungu.
81.am: ሕዝቡ በዓልን እንዲያከብሩ ይጠራሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤል እንዲሰሙትና በመንገዱ እንዲሄዱ እየናፈቀ ይናገራል።

82.en: God judges among the gods, rebuking them for failing to defend the weak and the fatherless, and the psalmist calls on God to judge the earth.
82.sw: Mungu anahukumu kati ya miungu, akiwakemea kwa kushindwa kuwatetea wanyonge na yatima, na mtunga zaburi anamwita Mungu aihukumu dunia.
82.am: እግዚአብሔር በአማልክት መካከል ይፈርዳል፤ ደካሞችንና ድሀ አደጎችን ስላልተሟገቱላቸው ይገሥጻቸዋል፤ መዝሙረኛውም እግዚአብሔር በምድር ላይ እንዲፈርድ ይጣራል።

83.en: Enemy nations conspire against Israel, and the psalmist asks God to deal with them as with enemies of old, so that they may know God alone is Most High.
83.sw: Mataifa adui yanafanya njama dhidi ya Israeli, na mtunga zaburi anamwomba Mungu ayatendee kama alivyowatendea adui wa zamani, ili yajue kwamba Mungu peke yake ndiye Aliye Juu Kabisa.
83.am: ጠላት ሕዝቦች በእስራኤል ላይ ይዶልታሉ፤ መዝሙረኛውም እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ልዑል እንደ ሆነ እንዲያውቁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጥንቶቹ ጠላቶች እንዲያደርግባቸው ይለምናል።

84.en: The psalmist longs for God's dwelling place; one day in God's courts is better than a thousand elsewhere.
84.sw: Mtunga zaburi anatamani makao ya Mungu; siku moja katika nyua za Mungu ni bora kuliko siku elfu mahali pengine.
84.am: መዝሙረኛው የእግዚአብሔርን ማደሪያ ይናፍቃል፤ በእግዚአብሔር አደባባዮች የሚውል አንድ ቀን በሌላ ስፍራ ከሚውሉ ሺህ ቀኖች ይበልጣል።

85.en: The people recall how God forgave and restored them and ask God to do so again; loyal love and faithfulness meet as friends, and righteousness and peace greet each other with a kiss.
85.sw: Watu wanakumbuka jinsi Mungu alivyowasamehe na kuwarejesha na wanamwomba afanye hivyo tena; upendo usiokoma na uaminifu vinakutana kama marafiki, na haki na amani vinasalimiana kwa busu.
85.am: ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር ይቅር እንዳላቸውና እንደ መለሳቸው ያስታውሳሉ፤ ዳግመኛም እንዲያደርግ ይለምኑታል፤ ጽኑ ፍቅርና እውነት እንደ ወዳጆች ይገናኛሉ፤ ጽድቅና ሰላምም ተሳስመው ሰላምታ ይለዋወጣሉ።

86.en: David, afflicted and in need, asks God to answer him and to teach him God's way, for God is merciful and gracious.
86.sw: Daudi, akiwa mnyonge na mhitaji, anamwomba Mungu amjibu na kumfundisha njia ya Mungu, kwa maana Mungu ni mwenye rehema na neema.
86.am: ዳዊት ተጨንቆና ችግረኛ ሆኖ እግዚአብሔር እንዲመልስለትና መንገዱን እንዲያስተምረው ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ቸር ነውና።

87.en: God loves Zion, and people of many nations will be counted as born there.
87.sw: Mungu anaipenda Sayuni, na watu wa mataifa mengi watahesabiwa kuwa wamezaliwa huko.
87.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ይወዳል፤ የብዙ ሕዝቦች ሰዎችም በዚያ እንደ ተወለዱ ይቈጠራሉ።

88.en: Heman cries out from the edge of death, abandoned by friends, with darkness as his only companion.
88.sw: Hemani analia kutoka ukingoni mwa kifo, ameachwa na rafiki zake, na giza ndilo rafiki yake pekee.
88.am: ሄማን ከሞት አፋፍ ይጮኻል፤ ወዳጆቹ ጥለውታል፤ ብቸኛ ባልንጀራውም ጨለማ ነው።

89.en: Ethan sings of God's loyal love and the covenant with David, then laments that God seems to have rejected the anointed king, and asks how long.
89.sw: Ethani anaimba juu ya upendo usiokoma wa Mungu na agano na Daudi, kisha anaomboleza kwamba Mungu anaonekana kumkataa mfalme aliyepakwa mafuta, na anauliza ni mpaka lini.
89.am: ኤታን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ፍቅርና ከዳዊት ጋር ስለ ተገባው ቃል ኪዳን ይዘምራል፤ ከዚያም እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን ንጉሥ የጣለው ስለሚመስል ያለቅሳል፤ እስከ መቼ እንደሆነም ይጠይቃል።

90.en: Moses prays to God, who has been the people's home in every generation, and asks God to teach them to reckon their days rightly and establish the work of their hands.
90.sw: Musa anamwomba Mungu, ambaye amekuwa makao ya watu wake katika kila kizazi, na anamwomba Mungu awafundishe kuzihesabu siku zao vizuri na kuithibitisha kazi ya mikono yao.
90.am: ሙሴ በትውልድ ሁሉ የሕዝቡ ማደሪያ ወደ ሆነው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጸልያል፤ ዘመናቸውን በአግባቡ መቍጠር እንዲያስተምራቸውና የእጃቸውን ሥራ እንዲያጸናም ይለምናል።

91.en: Whoever lives under the shelter of the Most High will be protected from every danger, for God promises to rescue the one who loves God.
91.sw: Yeyote anayekaa chini ya kifuniko cha Aliye Juu Kabisa atalindwa kutoka kwa kila hatari, kwa maana Mungu anaahidi kumwokoa yule anayempenda Mungu.
91.am: በልዑል ከለላ ሥር የሚኖር ሁሉ ከአደጋ ሁሉ ይጠበቃል፤ እግዚአብሔር የሚወደውን ሰው እንደሚያድነው ተስፋ ይሰጣልና።

92.en: It is good to give thanks to God, whose works are great; the righteous flourish like palm trees.
92.sw: Ni vyema kumshukuru Mungu, ambaye kazi zake ni kuu; waadilifu wanastawi kama mitende.
92.am: ሥራው ታላቅ የሆነውን እግዚአብሔርን ማመስገን መልካም ነው፤ ጻድቃን እንደ ዘንባባ ይለመልማሉ።

93.en: God is King, robed in majesty, mightier than the roaring waters, and God's decrees stand firm.
93.sw: Mungu ni Mfalme, amevikwa utukufu, mwenye nguvu kuliko maji yanayonguruma, na amri za Mungu zinasimama imara.
93.am: እግዚአብሔር ንጉሥ ነው፤ ግርማን ተጐናጽፏል፤ ከሚያገሡ ውኆች ይበልጥ ብርቱ ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ሥርዓት የጸና ነው።

94.en: The psalmist calls on God, the Judge of all the earth, to repay the arrogant, and finds comfort in God's support when his foot slips.
94.sw: Mtunga zaburi anamwita Mungu, Mwamuzi wa dunia yote, awalipe wenye kiburi, na anapata faraja katika msaada wa Mungu mguu wake unapoteleza.
94.am: መዝሙረኛው የምድር ሁሉ ዳኛ እግዚአብሔር ትዕቢተኞችን እንዲበቀል ይጣራል፤ እግሩ ሲያዳልጠውም በእግዚአብሔር ድጋፍ መጽናናትን ያገኛል።

95.en: The people are called to sing to God, the great King, and to worship, but warned not to harden their hearts as their ancestors did in the wilderness.
95.sw: Watu wanaitwa kumwimbia Mungu, Mfalme mkuu, na kuabudu, lakini wanaonywa wasiifanye mioyo yao kuwa migumu kama mababu zao walivyofanya jangwani.
95.am: ሕዝቡ ለታላቁ ንጉሥ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲዘምሩና እንዲሰግዱ ይጠራሉ፤ አባቶቻቸው በምድረ በዳ እንዳደረጉት ልባቸውን እንዳያደነድኑ ግን ይመከራሉ።

96.en: All the earth is called to sing a new song to God, who is to be feared above all gods and comes to judge the world in righteousness.
96.sw: Dunia yote inaitwa kumwimbia Mungu wimbo mpya, anayestahili kuogopwa kuliko miungu yote na anayekuja kuuhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki.
96.am: ምድር ሁሉ ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ሊፈራ ለሚገባውና ዓለምን በጽድቅ ሊፈርድ ለሚመጣው ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ መዝሙር እንድትዘምር ትጠራለች።

97.en: God is King; fire and lightning go before God, idols are put to shame, and the righteous rejoice.
97.sw: Mungu ni Mfalme; moto na umeme vinamtangulia, sanamu zinaaibishwa, na waadilifu wanafurahi.
97.am: እግዚአብሔር ንጉሥ ነው፤ እሳትና መብረቅ በፊቱ ይሄዳሉ፤ ጣዖታት ያፍራሉ፤ ጻድቃንም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

98.en: All the earth is called to sing a new song to God for the wonders God has done and the victory God has won, for God comes to judge.
98.sw: Dunia yote inaitwa kumwimbia Mungu wimbo mpya kwa ajili ya maajabu aliyoyatenda na ushindi aliopata, kwa maana Mungu anakuja kuhukumu.
98.am: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ስላደረገው ተአምራትና ስላገኘው ድል አዲስ መዝሙር እንድትዘምርለት ትጠራለች፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና።

99.en: God is King, enthroned on the cherubim, holy and just, who answered Moses, Aaron and Samuel.
99.sw: Mungu ni Mfalme, ameketi juu ya makerubi, mtakatifu na mwenye haki, aliyewajibu Musa, Haruni na Samweli.
99.am: እግዚአብሔር ንጉሥ ነው፤ በኪሩቤል ላይ ተቀምጧል፤ ቅዱስና ጻድቅ ነው፤ ሙሴን፣ አሮንንና ሳሙኤልን መለሰላቸው።

100.en: All the earth is called to shout for joy to God, who made us and whose loyal love lasts forever.
100.sw: Dunia yote inaitwa kumpigia Mungu kelele za furaha, aliyetuumba na ambaye upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele.
100.am: ምድር ሁሉ ለፈጠረንና ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ለሚኖረው ለእግዚአብሔር በደስታ እልል እንድትል ትጠራለች።

101.en: David resolves to live with integrity and to have nothing to do with the wicked.
101.sw: Daudi anaazimia kuishi kwa ukamilifu na kutojihusisha na waovu.
101.am: ዳዊት በንጹሕ አቋም ለመኖርና ከክፉዎች ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት ላለማድረግ ይቈርጣል።

102.en: A person in deep trouble pours out a complaint to God, whose years never end, and trusts that God will rebuild Zion.
102.sw: Mtu aliye katika taabu kubwa anamimina malalamiko yake kwa Mungu, ambaye miaka yake haina mwisho, na anatumaini kwamba Mungu ataijenga upya Sayuni.
102.am: በታላቅ መከራ ያለ ሰው ዘመኑ ፍጻሜ ለሌለው ለእግዚአብሔር ብሶቱን ያፈስሳል፤ እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን እንደ ገና እንደሚሠራትም ይታመናል።

103.en: The psalmist calls on himself to bless God, who forgives, heals and redeems, and whose loyal love is as high as the heavens.
103.sw: Mtunga zaburi anaiambia nafsi yake imbariki Mungu, anayesamehe, anayeponya na kukomboa, na ambaye upendo wake usiokoma uko juu kama mbingu.
103.am: መዝሙረኛው ይቅር የሚለውን፣ የሚፈውሰውንና የሚዋጀውን፣ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም እንደ ሰማያት ከፍ ያለውን እግዚአብሔርን እንድትባርክ ነፍሱን ያሳስባታል።

104.en: The psalmist blesses God for creation, the heavens, the waters, the creatures and the seasons, all of which look to God for life.
104.sw: Mtunga zaburi anambariki Mungu kwa ajili ya uumbaji, mbingu, maji, viumbe na majira, ambavyo vyote vinamtazamia Mungu kwa ajili ya uhai.
104.am: መዝሙረኛው ስለ ፍጥረት፣ ስለ ሰማያት፣ ስለ ውኆች፣ ስለ ፍጡራንና ስለ ወቅቶች እግዚአብሔርን ይባርካል፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ ሕይወትን ለማግኘት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይመለከታሉ።

105.en: The people are called to give thanks for God's covenant with Abraham and the wonders God did through Joseph, Moses and the exodus.
105.sw: Watu wanaitwa kushukuru kwa ajili ya agano la Mungu na Abrahamu na maajabu ambayo Mungu aliyatenda kupitia Yusufu, Musa na kutoka Misri.
105.am: ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር ከአብርሃም ጋር ስለ ገባው ቃል ኪዳን፣ በዮሴፍ፣ በሙሴና ከግብፅ በመውጣት ስላደረገው ተአምራት እንዲያመሰግኑ ይጠራሉ።

106.en: Israel confesses its repeated sins from Egypt to the land, and God's repeated mercy, and asks God to gather them from the nations.
106.sw: Israeli wanaungama dhambi zao zilizorudiwa tangu Misri hadi katika nchi, na rehema ya Mungu iliyorudiwa, na wanamwomba Mungu awakusanye kutoka kati ya mataifa.
106.am: እስራኤል ከግብፅ እስከ ምድሪቱ ድረስ የደጋገሙትን ኃጢአትና የእግዚአብሔርን ተደጋጋሚ ምሕረት ይናዘዛሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቦች መካከል እንዲሰበስባቸውም ይለምናሉ።

107.en: Those whom God has redeemed are called to give thanks: wanderers, prisoners, the sick and sailors in a storm all cried out, and God rescued them.
107.sw: Wale ambao Mungu amewakomboa wanaitwa kushukuru: wazururaji, wafungwa, wagonjwa na mabaharia katika dhoruba wote walilia, na Mungu akawaokoa.
107.am: እግዚአብሔር የዋጃቸው እንዲያመሰግኑ ይጠራሉ፦ ተቅበዝባዦች፣ እስረኞች፣ ሕመምተኞችና በማዕበል ውስጥ ያሉ መርከበኞች ሁሉ ጮኹ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አዳናቸው።

108.en: David's heart is firm, and he praises God among the nations and trusts God for victory.
108.sw: Moyo wa Daudi ni thabiti, naye anamsifu Mungu kati ya mataifa na kumtumaini Mungu kwa ajili ya ushindi.
108.am: የዳዊት ልብ የጸና ነው፤ በሕዝቦች መካከል እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል፤ ለድልም በእግዚአብሔር ይታመናል።

109.en: Attacked by liars, David asks God to deal with his accuser and to save him because of God's loyal love.
109.sw: Akishambuliwa na waongo, Daudi anamwomba Mungu amshughulikie mshtaki wake na kumwokoa kwa sababu ya upendo usiokoma wa Mungu.
109.am: ዳዊት በሐሰተኞች ተጠቅቶ እግዚአብሔር ከሳሹን እንዲቀጣውና ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ እንዲያድነው ይለምናል።

110.en: God declares to the king, "Take your seat at my right hand," and makes him a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
110.sw: Mungu anamwambia mfalme, "Keti mkono wangu wa kuume," na kumfanya kuhani wa milele kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.
110.am: እግዚአብሔር ንጉሡን «በቀኝ እጄ ተቀመጥ» ይለዋል፤ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓትም ለዘላለም ካህን ያደርገዋል።

111.en: The psalmist praises God's great works, faithful covenant and redemption; the fear of God is where wisdom begins.
111.sw: Mtunga zaburi anazisifu kazi kuu za Mungu, agano lake la uaminifu na ukombozi wake; kumcha Mungu ndiko chanzo cha hekima.
111.am: መዝሙረኛው የእግዚአብሔርን ታላላቅ ሥራዎች፣ የታመነ ቃል ኪዳኑንና ቤዛነቱን ያመሰግናል፤ የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው።

112.en: Those who fear God and delight in God's commands are blessed; they are generous and need not fear bad news.
112.sw: Wana heri wale wanaomcha Mungu na kufurahia amri za Mungu; ni wakarimu na hawahitaji kuogopa habari mbaya.
112.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩና በትእዛዙ ደስ የሚላቸው የተባረኩ ናቸው፤ ለጋሶች ናቸው፤ ክፉ ወሬም ሊያስፈራቸው አይገባም።

113.en: The servants of God are called to praise the name of God, who is enthroned on high and lifts up the poor.
113.sw: Watumishi wa Mungu wanaitwa kulisifu jina la Mungu, aliyeketi juu na anayewainua maskini.
113.am: የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋዮች በከፍታ ላይ የተቀመጠውንና ድሆችን የሚያነሣውን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም እንዲያመሰግኑ ይጠራሉ።

114.en: When Israel left Egypt, the sea fled and the mountains skipped before God.
114.sw: Israeli walipotoka Misri, bahari ilikimbia na milima ikarukaruka mbele za Mungu.
114.am: እስራኤል ከግብፅ በወጡ ጊዜ ባሕሩ ሸሸ፤ ተራሮችም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘለሉ።

115.en: Glory belongs to God's name, not to us; idols are lifeless, but God blesses those who trust in God.
115.sw: Utukufu ni wa jina la Mungu, si wetu; sanamu hazina uhai, lakini Mungu huwabariki wale wanaomtumaini Mungu.
115.am: ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር ስም እንጂ ለእኛ አይደለም፤ ጣዖታት ሕይወት የላቸውም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን በእርሱ የሚታመኑትን ይባርካል።

116.en: The psalmist loves God, who heard his cry when death surrounded him, and he will keep his vows.
116.sw: Mtunga zaburi anampenda Mungu, aliyesikia kilio chake kifo kilipomzunguka, naye atatimiza nadhiri zake.
116.am: መዝሙረኛው ሞት በከበበው ጊዜ ጩኸቱን የሰማውን እግዚአብሔርን ይወዳል፤ ስእለቱንም ይፈጽማል።

117.en: All nations are called to praise God, whose loyal love is great.
117.sw: Mataifa yote yanaitwa kumsifu Mungu, ambaye upendo wake usiokoma ni mkuu.
117.am: ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ታላቅ የሆነውን እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመሰግኑ ይጠራሉ።

118.en: The people give thanks to God, whose loyal love lasts forever; the stone the builders cast aside is now the stone at the head of the corner.
118.sw: Watu wanamshukuru Mungu, ambaye upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele; jiwe ambalo wajenzi walilitupa sasa ni jiwe lililo kichwa cha pembe.
118.am: ሕዝቡ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም የሚኖረውን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናሉ፤ ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ የማዕዘን ራስ ድንጋይ ሆኗል።

119.en: In twenty-two sections, one for each letter of the alphabet, the psalmist delights in God's instruction, prays to keep it, and finds it a lamp for his feet.
119.sw: Katika sehemu ishirini na mbili, moja kwa kila herufi ya alfabeti, mtunga zaburi anafurahia mafundisho ya Mungu, anaomba ayashike, na anaona kwamba ni taa ya miguu yake.
119.am: መዝሙረኛው ለእያንዳንዱ የፊደል ገበታ ፊደል አንድ በሆኑ ሃያ ሁለት ክፍሎች በእግዚአብሔር ትምህርት ደስ ይለዋል፤ ሊጠብቀውም ይጸልያል፤ ለእግሩም መብራት ሆኖ ያገኘዋል።

120.en: In trouble among liars and people who hate peace, the psalmist cries out to God.
120.sw: Akiwa katika taabu kati ya waongo na watu wanaochukia amani, mtunga zaburi anamlilia Mungu.
120.am: መዝሙረኛው በሐሰተኞችና ሰላምን በሚጠሉ ሰዎች መካከል በመከራ ሳለ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻል።

121.en: The psalmist's help comes from God, who made heaven and earth and who will guard his going out and coming in.
121.sw: Msaada wa mtunga zaburi unatoka kwa Mungu, aliyeziumba mbingu na nchi na atakayemlinda anapoondoka na anaporudi.
121.am: የመዝሙረኛው ርዳታ ሰማይንና ምድርን ከፈጠረው ሲነሣና ሲመለስ ከሚጠብቀው ከእግዚአብሔር ይመጣል።

122.en: Pilgrims rejoice to stand in Jerusalem and pray for its peace.
122.sw: Wasafiri wa hija wanafurahi kusimama ndani ya Yerusalemu na wanaomba amani yake.
122.am: ተሳላሚዎች በኢየሩሳሌም በመቆማቸው ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ስለ ሰላሟም ይጸልያሉ።

123.en: As servants watch their master's hand, the people look to God for mercy.
123.sw: Kama watumishi wanavyoutazama mkono wa bwana wao, ndivyo watu wanavyomtazama Mungu kwa ajili ya rehema.
123.am: አገልጋዮች የጌታቸውን እጅ እንደሚመለከቱ ሕዝቡ ምሕረትን ለማግኘት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይመለከታሉ።

124.en: If God had not been on Israel's side, they would have been swept away; their help is in God's name.
124.sw: Kama Mungu hangekuwa upande wa Israeli, wangekuwa wamefagiliwa mbali; msaada wao uko katika jina la Mungu.
124.am: እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ጋር ባይሆን ኖሮ ተጠራርገው በሄዱ ነበር፤ ርዳታቸው በእግዚአብሔር ስም ነው።

125.en: Those who trust God are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken.
125.sw: Wale wanaomtumaini Mungu ni kama Mlima Sayuni, ambao hauwezi kutikiswa.
125.am: በእግዚአብሔር የሚታመኑ እንደማይናወጠው እንደ ጽዮን ተራራ ናቸው።

126.en: When God restored Zion's fortunes the people laughed for joy, and they pray that those who sow in tears will reap with songs of joy.
126.sw: Mungu alipoirudishia Sayuni hali yake njema watu walicheka kwa furaha, na wanaomba kwamba wale wanaopanda kwa machozi wavune kwa nyimbo za furaha.
126.am: እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ዕድል ፈንታ በመለሰ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ በደስታ ሣቁ፤ በእንባ የሚዘሩም በደስታ ዝማሬ እንዲያጭዱ ይጸልያሉ።

127.en: Unless God builds the house, its builders work in vain; children are a gift from God.
127.sw: Ikiwa Mungu hajengi nyumba, wajenzi wake wanafanya kazi bure; watoto ni zawadi kutoka kwa Mungu.
127.am: እግዚአብሔር ቤቱን ካልሠራ ሠራተኞቹ በከንቱ ይደክማሉ፤ ልጆች ከእግዚአብሔር የተሰጡ ስጦታ ናቸው።

128.en: Those who fear God are blessed with fruitful work and family.
128.sw: Wale wanaomcha Mungu wanabarikiwa kwa kazi yenye matunda na familia.
128.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩ ፍሬያማ በሆነ ሥራና በቤተ ሰብ ይባረካሉ።

129.en: Israel's enemies have attacked since its youth but have not prevailed, and the psalmist prays that they will be put to shame.
129.sw: Adui wa Israeli wameishambulia tangu ujana wake lakini hawajaishinda, na mtunga zaburi anaomba waaibishwe.
129.am: የእስራኤል ጠላቶች ከልጅነቷ ጀምሮ አጥቅተዋታል፤ ግን አላሸነፏትም፤ መዝሙረኛውም እንዲያፍሩ ይጸልያል።

130.en: From the depths the psalmist cries to God, who forgives, and he waits for God more than watchmen wait for morning.
130.sw: Kutoka vilindini mtunga zaburi anamlilia Mungu, anayesamehe, naye anamngojea Mungu kuliko walinzi wa usiku wanavyoingoja asubuhi.
130.am: መዝሙረኛው ከጥልቅ ይቅር ወደሚለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻል፤ የሌሊት ዘበኞች ንጋትን ከሚጠብቁ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን ይጠብቃል።

131.en: The psalmist has calmed and quieted himself like a weaned child, and urges Israel to hope in God.
131.sw: Mtunga zaburi amejituliza na kujinyamazisha kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya, na anawahimiza Israeli wamtumaini Mungu.
131.am: መዝሙረኛው ጡት እንደ ጣለ ሕፃን ራሱን አረጋግቷል፤ ጸጥም ብሏል፤ እስራኤልም እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ እንዲያደርጉ ያሳስባል።

132.en: The people ask God to remember David, and God swears to keep David's line on the throne and to dwell in Zion.
132.sw: Watu wanamwomba Mungu amkumbuke Daudi, na Mungu anaapa kuuweka ukoo wa Daudi kwenye kiti cha enzi na kukaa Sayuni.
132.am: ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር ዳዊትን እንዲያስብ ይለምናሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የዳዊትን ዘር በዙፋኑ ላይ ሊያጸና በጽዮንም ሊያድር ይምላል።

133.en: How good it is when God's people live together in unity.
133.sw: Ni vizuri namna gani watu wa Mungu wanapoishi pamoja kwa umoja.
133.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ በአንድነት አብረው ሲኖሩ እንዴት መልካም ነው።

134.en: The servants of God in the house of God are called to bless God at night.
134.sw: Watumishi wa Mungu walio katika nyumba ya Mungu wanaitwa kumbariki Mungu usiku.
134.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያሉ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋዮች በሌሊት እግዚአብሔርን እንዲባርኩ ይጠራሉ።

135.en: The people praise God, who chose Jacob, does whatever God pleases and brought Israel out of Egypt; idols are lifeless.
135.sw: Watu wanamsifu Mungu, aliyemchagua Yakobo, anayefanya lolote apendalo na aliyewatoa Israeli Misri; sanamu hazina uhai.
135.am: ሕዝቡ ያዕቆብን የመረጠውን፣ የወደደውን ሁሉ የሚያደርገውንና እስራኤልን ከግብፅ ያወጣውን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናሉ፤ ጣዖታት ሕይወት የላቸውም።

136.en: Each line of thanks to God for creation and for rescuing Israel answers that God’s loyal love lasts forever.
136.sw: Kila mstari wa shukrani kwa Mungu kwa ajili ya uumbaji na kwa kuwaokoa Israeli unajibiwa kwamba upendo usiokoma wa Mungu unadumu milele.
136.am: ስለ ፍጥረትና እስራኤልን ስለ ማዳኑ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቀርብ እያንዳንዱ የምስጋና መስመር የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ፍቅር ለዘላለም ይኖራል ተብሎ ይመለሳል።

137.en: By the rivers of Babylon the exiles weep as they remember Zion and cannot sing God's song in a foreign land.
137.sw: Kando ya mito ya Babeli watu walio uhamishoni wanalia wanapoikumbuka Sayuni, na hawawezi kuuimba wimbo wa Mungu katika nchi ya wageni.
137.am: በባቢሎን ወንዞች ዳር ምርኮኞቹ ጽዮንን እያሰቡ ያለቅሳሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ዝማሬ በእንግዶች አገር ሊዘምሩ አይችሉም።

138.en: David gives thanks for God's loyal love and faithfulness, for God looks on the lowly and will fulfill God's purpose for him.
138.sw: Daudi anashukuru kwa ajili ya upendo usiokoma wa Mungu na uaminifu wake, kwa maana Mungu anawaangalia wanyonge na atalitimiza kusudi lake kwa ajili yake.
138.am: ዳዊት ስለ እግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ፍቅርና እውነት ያመሰግናል፤ እግዚአብሔር ትሑታንን ይመለከታልና፤ ለእርሱም ያለውን ዓላማ ይፈጽማል።

139.en: God knows the psalmist completely, is present everywhere and formed him in the womb; he asks God to search him and lead him.
139.sw: Mungu anamjua mtunga zaburi kabisa, yuko kila mahali na alimuumba tumboni; anamwomba Mungu amchunguze na kumwongoza.
139.am: እግዚአብሔር መዝሙረኛውን ፈጽሞ ያውቀዋል፤ በሁሉ ስፍራ አለ፤ በማኅፀንም ሠራው፤ እርሱም እግዚአብሔር እንዲመረምረውና እንዲመራው ይለምናል።

140.en: David asks God to rescue him from violent and slanderous people.
140.sw: Daudi anamwomba Mungu amwokoe kutoka kwa watu wenye jeuri na wasingiziaji.
140.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ከግፈኞችና ከሐሜተኞች እንዲያድነው ይለምናል።

141.en: David asks God to keep watch over his mouth and to keep him from the snares of the wicked.
141.sw: Daudi anamwomba Mungu alinde kinywa chake na amzuie na mitego ya waovu.
141.am: ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር አፉን እንዲጠብቅና ከክፉዎች ወጥመድ እንዲጠብቀው ይለምናል።

142.en: In the cave David cries out to God, for no one cares for him, and God is his refuge.
142.sw: Pangoni Daudi anamlilia Mungu, kwa maana hakuna anayemjali, na Mungu ni kimbilio lake.
142.am: ዳዊት በዋሻው ውስጥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻል፤ የሚያስብለት የለምና፤ እግዚአብሔርም መጠጊያው ነው።

143.en: David pleads for mercy, for no one living is righteous before God, and asks God to teach him to do God's will.
143.sw: Daudi anaomba rehema, kwa maana hakuna aliye hai aliye mwadilifu mbele za Mungu, na anamwomba Mungu amfundishe kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu.
143.am: ዳዊት ምሕረትን ይለምናል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሕያው የሆነ ጻድቅ የለምና፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ ማድረግም እንዲያስተምረው ይለምናል።

144.en: David blesses God, his rock, who trains him for battle, and prays for a blessed and prosperous people.
144.sw: Daudi anambariki Mungu, mwamba wake, anayemfundisha vita, na anaomba watu wabarikiwe na kufanikiwa.
144.am: ዳዊት ለጦርነት የሚያሠለጥነውን ዓለቱን እግዚአብሔርን ይባርካል፤ ለተባረከና ለበለጸገ ሕዝብም ይጸልያል።

145.en: David praises God, the King, who is gracious and merciful, near to all who call, and whose kingdom lasts forever.
145.sw: Daudi anamsifu Mungu, Mfalme, aliye mwenye neema na rehema, aliye karibu na wote wanaomwita, na ambaye ufalme wake unadumu milele.
145.am: ዳዊት ቸርና መሓሪ የሆነውን፣ ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ ቅርብ የሆነውንና መንግሥቱ ለዘላለም የሚኖረውን ንጉሡን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል።

146.en: The psalmist will praise God all his life, for God, not princes, made heaven and earth and gives justice to the oppressed.
146.sw: Mtunga zaburi atamsifu Mungu maisha yake yote, kwa maana Mungu, si wakuu, ndiye aliyeziumba mbingu na nchi na huwapa haki walioonewa.
146.am: መዝሙረኛው በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል፤ ሰማይንና ምድርን የፈጠረና ለተጨቈኑት ፍትሕን የሚሰጥ ከመኳንንት ሳይሆን እግዚአብሔር ነውና።

147.en: God rebuilds Jerusalem, heals the brokenhearted, counts the stars and sends the snow, and delights in those who fear God.
147.sw: Mungu anaijenga upya Yerusalemu, anawaponya waliovunjika moyo, anazihesabu nyota na kutuma theluji, na anapendezwa na wale wanaomcha.
147.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን እንደ ገና ይሠራል፤ ልባቸው የተሰበረውን ይፈውሳል፤ ከዋክብትን ይቈጥራል፤ በረዶን ይልካል፤ በሚፈሩትም ደስ ይለዋል።

148.en: The heavens, the earth and all creatures are called to praise God.
148.sw: Mbingu, nchi na viumbe vyote vinaitwa kumsifu Mungu.
148.am: ሰማያት፣ ምድርና ፍጡራን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመሰግኑ ይጠራሉ።

149.en: The faithful are called to sing a new song and to praise God with dancing, for God delights in the people.
149.sw: Waaminifu wanaitwa kuimba wimbo mpya na kumsifu Mungu kwa kucheza, kwa maana Mungu anapendezwa na watu wake.
149.am: ታማኞች አዲስ መዝሙር እንዲዘምሩና እግዚአብሔርን በዘፈን እንዲያመሰግኑ ይጠራሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ደስ ይለዋልና።

150.en: Everything that has breath is called to praise God with trumpet, harp, strings and cymbals.
150.sw: Kila kiumbe kinachopumua kinaitwa kumsifu Mungu kwa tarumbeta, kinubi, ala za nyuzi na matoazi.
150.am: የሚተነፍስ ፍጥረት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን በመለከት፣ በበገና፣ በባለ አውታር መሣሪያዎችና በጸናጽል እንዲያመሰግን ይጠራል።
